The '''2022–23 [[Cypriot First Division]]''' was the 84th season of the Cypriot top-level [[Association football|football]] league.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://www.cfa.com.cy/Gr/news/43703|title=Λεπτομέρειες για τον αγωνιστικό προγραμματισμό του 2022-2023|date=23 February 2022|website=www.cfa.com.cy|publisher=[[Cyprus Football Association|CFA]]|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220430175925/https://www.cfa.com.cy/Gr/news/43703|archivedate=30 April 2022|accessdate=16 July 2022}}</ref>

== Competition system ==
14 teams participated in the 2022–23 First Division.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=https://www.cfa.com.cy/images/DownloadsGr/%CE%A0%CF%81%CE%BF%CE%BA%CE%AE%CF%81%CF%85%CE%BE%CE%B7%20%CE%91%CE%84%20%CE%9A%CE%B1%CF%84%CE%B7%CE%B3%CE%BF%CF%81%CE%AF%CE%B1%CF%82-2022-2023.pdf|title=Προκήρυξη Πρωταθλήματος Α' Κατηγορίας 2022-2023|date=4 July 2022|website=www.cfa.com.cy|publisher=[[Cyprus Football Association|CFA]]|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220707174409/https://www.cfa.com.cy/images/DownloadsGr/%CE%A0%CF%81%CE%BF%CE%BA%CE%AE%CF%81%CF%85%CE%BE%CE%B7%20%CE%91%CE%84%20%CE%9A%CE%B1%CF%84%CE%B7%CE%B3%CE%BF%CF%81%CE%AF%CE%B1%CF%82-2022-2023.pdf|archivedate=7 July 2022|accessdate=16 July 2022}}</ref>

It was conducted in two phases. In the first phase, all teams played each other twice, one at home and one away. After the completion of the 26 matches (A phase) the teams participated in 2 groups (depending on their position) and played ranking matches (B phase). The results, points and goals of the A' phase were transferred to the matches. The teams in places 1–6 competed for the championship and places leading to the European championships. The teams faced each other twice, one at home and one away.<ref name=":0" /> The team with the most points was declared the champion.<ref name=":1" /> The champion team secured their place in the [[2023–24 UEFA Champions League]]. In addition, the teams finishing in second and third place secured their participation in the [[2023–24 UEFA Europa Conference League]].

The teams in positions 7–14 faced each other twice, one at home and one away.<ref name=":0" /> The bottom three teams were relegated to the [[Cypriot Second Division|Second Division]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.cfa.com.cy/Gr/news/41979|title=Ο προγραμματισμός των Πρωταθλημάτων ΚΟΠ μέχρι το 2024-2025|date=14 June 2021|website=|publisher=[[Cyprus Football Association|CFA]]|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220430175931/https://www.cfa.com.cy/Gr/news/41979|archivedate=30 April 2022|accessdate=16 July 2022}}</ref><ref name=":1" />

== Changes compared to the previous season ==
In relation to the [[2021–22 Cypriot First Division|2021–22 season]], the teams promoted from the [[Cypriot Second Division|Second Division]] will participate in the 2022–23 First Division are [[Karmiotissa Polemidion FC|Karmiotissa]], [[Nea Salamis Famagusta FC|New Salamina]], [[Akritas Chlorakas]] and [[Enosis Neon Paralimni FC|Enosis Neon Paralimni]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.cfa.com.cy/Gr/news/44258|title=Β' Κατηγορία: Ανεβαίνουν Καρμιώτισσα Πολεμιδιών, Νέα Σαλαμίνα, Ακρίτας Χλώρακας και ΕΝ Παραλιμνίου|date=1 May
